'''Remembrance Hall''' was a museum in [[Forard]], on [[Almas]].

==History==
Remembrance Hall was used by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Almas Academy]] as a museum to display various artifacts, including a [[holoplacard]] of [[Ood Bnar]] fighting during the [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|Battle of Ossus]]. [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] from the Academy, such as [[Tinya]], would serve as tour guides in the museum. However, after it was attacked by terrorists, the holoplacard of Ood Bnar was destroyed.

Following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Almas was abandoned and Remembrance Hall was covered in graffiti, that said ''DEATH TO THE UNFAITHFUL''. This was probably written by members of the [[Believers]].
